text:
emily.p: FYI vendor ArcticFreight just told us customs in NL pulled one pallet for additional paperwork. They flagged 're-marked serials' on 6 units and want a supporting letter + original manufacturer CO to clear. This is the partial H100 refurb shipment (12 units total). Could affect EU staging capacity next week.

ben.r: ouch. which AWB and how long for paperwork? do they suggest loaners?

vendor-arctic: AWB: ARCT-459002. Customs requests: (1) manufacturer CO (original) + (2) a statement that these are refurbished units with serial traceability. We can provide commercial invoice + refurb trace PDF but OEM CO may take 48272h. Customs may release on provisionary bond if we pay a release fee.

logistics-ryan: two options: (A) pay provisional release fee via local broker (~€3.5k) for immediate release 6h; (B) vendor dispatch loaners from our UK CDN pool (6 units) same-day if we sign return SLA and RMA labels. Forwarder quote for urgent release (option A) is €3.5k; alternate express forwarder quote for sending loaners door-to-door is €4.9k.

warehouse-frank: we have 4 H100 loaners in AMS staging and 2 in LON hot-rack that can be shipped. Need RMA paperwork and serial checklist. If loaners go out, we'll stamp temporary asset tags and track in Loaner Ledger.

ops-alert-bot: cluster-health: eu-prod pool predicted deficit ~8 H100-equivalent units in 48h under current degradation trend. Canary traffic shows 12% p99 increase for real-time rerank. Recommend loaners or priority routing to other regions.

emily.p: vendor, can you dispatch loaners while customs sorts originals? And can vendor accept return via local depot?

vendor-arctic: yes we can dispatch loaners as a separate AWB (LOAN-ARCT-900). We require a signed return SLA + RMA labels on CI. We can ship in 6h once SLA received. Note: loaners are refurb grade B with warranty swap terms.

ben.r: finance signoff thresholds? what's the minimum vendor contribution for customs fee?

finance-anna: vendor offered to cover up to €1.5k of customs/bond fees as a goodwill credit. Redwood would need to cover the rest. Procurement threshold for releases >€3k requires 2-up approval.

logistics-ryan: SkyForwarder door-to-door loaner ETA 102h for €4.9k. Local broker provisional release ETA 6h for €3.5k. If vendor sends loaners, we'll still need RMA labels/return PO.

warehouse-frank: prepping RMA label template now: CSV columns: SERIAL, MODEL, CI_AWB, CONDITION, RETURN_AWB. Will attach sample. Also note: one serial in AMS has a recent power-cycle warning flagged by OEM telemetry; ops wants a 20min burn test before shipping.

ops-alert-bot: QA steps for loaners: flash verified image, run stress 20min, record idle temp, run simple nvlink test. Tag any unit failing >85C and swap. Estimated bench time per unit: 40min including image.

emily.p: if we accept loaners, who signs SLA? can procurement/finance sign emergency PO?

finance-anna: we can pre-approve emergency PO up to €6k for logistics if ops declares critical impact. Need one exec-sponsor sign afterwards.

ben.r: ops declares critical (per op-bot). Emily, approve vendor LOAN SLA and we'll issue return PO and take SkyForwarder if vendor can't confirm pickup window <8h.

emily.p: approved. @vendor-arctic send SLA template now. We'll route emergency PO if needed.

vendor-arctic: SLA sent: https://files.vendor/arctic/sla-loan-template.pdf. Starting LOAN AWB LOAN-ARCT-900, tentative pickup 7h window.

logistics-ryan: booking SkyForwarder standby (non-confirmed) while vendor finalizes. If vendor loaner pickup slips >8h we execute SkyForwarder (€4.9k).

ben.r: action items recap: (1) vendor send signed SLA + loan AWB and CI with "temporary loan" marking 1; (2) warehouse run 20min burn on 6 loaners and prep RMA CSV; (3) finance pre-issue emergency PO up to €6k if vendor loaner pickup delayed; (4) procurement request partial vendor credit for customs/bond fees.

vendor-arctic: Confirmed. We'll include refurb trace PDF and label loaners clearly. Expect signed SLA within 1h.

emily.p: thanks all 1 will monitor. post updates here.
